name: ranked_no_self_dependency
description: Typed status or dependency-rank invariant. Correct source interpretation and rank assignment are assumptions.
code:
theorem ranked_no_self_dependency (edge : α → α → Prop) (rank : α → Nat)
    (h : Ranked edge rank) (x : α) : ¬edge x x := by
  intro hx
  have := h x x hx
  omega

name: ranked_no_two_cycle
description: Typed status or dependency-rank invariant. Correct source interpretation and rank assignment are assumptions.
code:
theorem ranked_no_two_cycle (edge : α → α → Prop) (rank : α → Nat)
    (h : Ranked edge rank) (a b : α) : ¬(edge a b ∧ edge b a) := by
  rintro ⟨hab, hba⟩
  have := h a b hab
  have := h b a hba
  omega

inductive Path (edge : α → α → Prop) : α → α → Prop where
  | single : edge a b → Path edge a b
  | next : Path edge a b → edge b c → Path edge a c

name: path_increases_rank
description: Typed status or dependency-rank invariant. Correct source interpretation and rank assignment are assumptions.
code:
theorem path_increases_rank (edge : α → α → Prop) (rank : α → Nat)
    (h : Ranked edge rank) (p : Path edge a b) : rank a < rank b := by
  induction p with
  | single he => exact h _ _ he
  | next _ he ih => exact Nat.lt_trans ih (h _ _ he)

name: ranked_no_cycle
description: Typed status or dependency-rank invariant. Correct source interpretation and rank assignment are assumptions.
code:
theorem ranked_no_cycle (edge : α → α → Prop) (rank : α → Nat)
    (h : Ranked edge rank) (x : α) : ¬Path edge x x := by
  intro p
  have := path_increases_rank edge rank h p
  omega

name: positive_update_requires_prior
description: Natural-number weight update. Positive mass and correctly specified likelihoods are separate obligations.
code:
theorem positive_update_requires_prior (w l : α → Nat) (x : α)
    (h : support (revise w l) x) : support w x := by
  cases hw : w x with
  | zero => simp [support, revise, hw] at h
  | succ n => simp [support, hw]

  Nat.mul_pos hw hl

    (id oldRevision newRevision : Nat) (h : oldRevision ≠ newRevision) :

  intro eq
  have : newRevision = oldRevision := congrArg Proposal.revision eq
  exact h this.symm
